From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Sent: Thursday, October 1, 2020 8:27 AM
To: Cindy Ronald <cindy.ronald@gmail.com>
Subject: Re: Detroit Tigers Refund 
 
Hello Cindy,

I am sorry to hear about your current situation. Unfortunately, there isn't much I can do about this. I was re-assigned from the Tigers beat two months ago. I did, however, pass along your e-mail to Kaliq's personal e-mail address. Perhaps that will give him a nudge. Again, I wish I was able to do more -- I miss telling readers the truth about what is going on in there.

Anthony
From: Cindy Ronald <cindy.ronald@gmail.com>
Sent: Tuesday, September 29, 2020 8:48 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Detroit Tigers Refund 
 
Hello Anthony,
I am at a loss and am hoping you can help.

I have contacted the Detroit Tigers through email numerous times enquiring where is my refund for tickets. I purchased 4 tickets over two days for the Jays vs. Tigers back in June. (TGEV - 3572883 - 40962082)
According to the Tigers news release on July 6, they stated "If you wish you receive a refund for impacted 2020 Detroit Tigers Home Games, please e-mail us at tickets@tigers.com”.

I emailed July 28 asking when I can expect to see my refund on my credit card. No response. I emailed again August 4. I got a reply from Kaliq Carr saying he would be in touch soon for next steps. I emailed again August 11 and 14. Finally he replied that the refund request was sent to the box office. The refund never showed up on my credit card. I have emailed repeatedly since - September 17, 21, 22, and 25. There has been no response. The ticket office is closed, so I can’t speak to anyone there.

I tried to phone Kaliq Carr's cell as his email directed, but it would not accept my call.  As I said, I have emailed numerous times asking when my refund of $483.10 will be put back on my credit card.

I truly do not understand the delay and I am extremely frustrated. Cleveland Indians refunded my credit card back on July 18 for tickets I purchased from them, so what is the issue with Detroit Tigers?

Regards,
Cynthia Ronald
West Lorne ON Canada
